### THE VILLAS Caesars Palace Ranked Number One Casino Hotel in AAA’s Inaugural List


10/13/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF 511 KB](https://s202.q4cdn.com/508919455/files/doc_news/THE-VILLAS-Caesars-Palace-Ranked-Number-One-Casino-Hotel-in-AAAs-Inaugural-List-2026.pdf)


**Four Caesars Entertainment Las Vegas Resorts Earn AAA Diamond Designations**


*THE VILLAS Caesars Palace retained AAA Five Diamond designation; The Vanderpump Hotel, Caesars Palace and Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace earned AAA Four Diamond designations*


****For high-res images of THE VILLAS Caesars Palace, click***[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdrive.google.com%2Fdrive%2Ffolders%2F1z2UtRL6edUfMNgNyn6J-kSodxuGvQsJn%3Fusp%3Dsharing&esheet=54620399&newsitemid=20261012086525&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=1&md5=df7c6762f9c7ea421f63f35902ae61fd) ***** **For high-res images of Caesars Palace and Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace, click***[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdrive.google.com%2Fdrive%2Ffolders%2F1aGFNFgnlN6bDxe2GKUg2ItWOr4iu77uc%3Fusp%3Dsharing&esheet=54620399&newsitemid=20261012086525&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=2&md5=ffb4985ee59b4b7fea9d3481f8de1b70) ***** **For high-res images of The Vanderpump Hotel, click***[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdrive.google.com%2Fdrive%2Ffolders%2F1TnfR58LajhvKe9yf37WSYrg93faqPUE_%3Fusp%3Dsharing&esheet=54620399&newsitemid=20261012086525&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=3&md5=53cf377b23fb552af1497c56b102763f) *******


**Key Facts**


- THE VILLAS Caesars Palace was the top-ranked casino hotel among 161 AAA-rated casino hotels and resorts across the U.S., Canada, Mexico, Costa Rica and the Caribbean.
- THE VILLAS Caesars Palace earned the AAA Five Diamond designation for the second consecutive year.
- The Vanderpump Hotel earned the AAA Four Diamond designation during its first three months of operations.
- Caesars Palace and Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace retained their AAA Four Diamond designations for the second consecutive year.


LAS VEGAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


THE VILLAS Caesars Palace, the exclusive collection of luxury accommodations within the iconic Las Vegas Strip resort, was named Number One casino hotel among 161 AAA-rated casino hotels and resorts across the U.S., Canada, Mexico, Costa Rica and the Caribbean in the inaugural Top 10 ranking.


THE VILLAS Caesars Palace also retained its prestigious AAA Five Diamond designation for the second consecutive year. Caesars Palace and Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace once again earned the AAA Four Diamond designation. The Vanderpump Hotel, the newest boutique hotel on The Strip, achieved its first AAA Four Diamond designation within its first three months of operation.


Less than 1% of nearly 23,000 AAA Diamond-designated hotels achieve Five Diamond status, recognizing properties that deliver world-class luxury, exceptional service and highly personalized guest experiences. AAA Four Diamond properties are recognized for upscale accommodations, elevated amenities and exceptional attention to detail.


“The AAA recognition earned by THE VILLAS Caesars Palace, Caesars Palace, Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace and The Vanderpump Hotel is a testament to the passion and dedication of our Team Members,” said Terrence O'Donnell, SVP and General Manager of the resorts. “This year, we celebrated six decades of Caesars Palace and welcomed The Vanderpump Hotel to our portfolio, showcasing both our legacy and our continued evolution. This distinction reflects our commitment to creating extraordinary experiences for our guests, and we're proud to see that effort recognized by one of the travel industry's most respected organizations."


To earn AAA Diamond recognition, hotels undergo rigorous evaluations, including unannounced inspections and anonymous overnight stays. Properties are assessed on service, accommodations, amenities and overall guest experience, with annual re-evaluations to ensure standards are maintained.


**THE VILLAS Caesars Palace Ranked Number One Casino Hotel and Retained AAA Five Diamond Designation**


Recognized as one of the world’s most elite hospitality offerings, THE VILLAS Caesars Palace has hosted a distinguished roster of guests, including celebrities, dignitaries and royalty. From the moment villa guests arrive, their elevated stay begins with private airport transportation, arrival through an exclusive porte cochere and a dedicated butler or concierge to welcome them. Guests enjoy personalized service from a 24-hour butler, gourmet in-villa dining and a dedicated pre-arrival concierge who curates every detail of their stay. Select residences also offer private elevators and direct access to the Garden of the Gods Pool Oasis.


**The Vanderpump Hotel Earned AAA Four Diamond Designation for the First Time**


The Vanderpump Hotel brings a bold new experience to the Las Vegas Strip through a partnership between Caesars Entertainment and television personality and entrepreneur Lisa Vanderpump. Opened in 2026, the 188-room boutique hotel has quickly become a standout destination, earning its first AAA Four Diamond designation. Featuring bespoke design elements, elegant interiors and thoughtful touches throughout each guest room and suite, the hotel reflects Vanderpump's signature aesthetic.


**Caesars Palace Retained AAA Four Diamond Designation**


As Caesars Palace celebrates its 60th anniversary, the resort continues to elevate the guest experience through significant property-wide enhancements. Recent investments include renovations to the main entrance, casino dome, Qua Baths & Spa and fitness center; redesigned Flavian Sky Suites; the debut of Palace Court Slots and Aureus Lounge high-limit gaming areas; and the openings of Celebrity Food Hall, Caspian's Cocktails & Caviar and OMNIA Dayclub & Skybar. This year, Caesars Palace also introduced two new Presidential Villas in the Colosseum Tower and 29 Sky Villas in the Octavius Tower, all designed by Peter Silling & Associates.


Upcoming enhancements include:


- Augustus Tower – Nearly 1,000 suites will undergo a complete renovation designed by Peter Silling & Associates.
- VIP Check-In Lounge – Caesars Palace's premium hospitality and gaming guests will soon enjoy a new arrival and check-in experience.
- Julius Tower – More than 500 guest rooms will be fully renovated.
- Palace Tower – Nearly 1,200 guest rooms will receive a complete redesign.


**Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace Retained AAA Four Diamond Designation**


Caesars Palace is also home to the world’s first Nobu Hotel. The boutique hotel within the larger resort blends Japanese-inspired design with contemporary luxury, offering 182 guest rooms and suites, including penthouses and a 10,300-square-foot villa. Guests at Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace enjoy priority seating at Nobu Restaurant and access to an exclusive in-room dining menu featuring Nobu breakfast.

**FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions)**


**What is the difference between a AAA Four Diamond and AAA Five Diamond designation?**


AAA Four Diamond hotels offer upscale accommodations, elevated amenities and exceptional hospitality. AAA Five Diamond properties represent the highest level of luxury, featuring world-class service, refined design and highly personalized guest experiences.


**How many Las Vegas hotels and resorts earned the AAA Five Diamond designation in 2026?**


Only three Las Vegas hotels earned the AAA Five Diamond designation in 2026, including THE VILLAS Caesars Palace.


**What amenities are available at THE VILLAS Caesars Palace?**


Guests enjoy private airport transportation, dedicated butler service, personalized concierge assistance, gourmet in-villa dining and access to exclusive amenities. Select villas also feature private elevators, plunge pools, media rooms and direct access to the Garden of the Gods Pool Oasis.


**Which villas are included in THE VILLAS Caesars Palace?**


THE VILLAS Caesars Palace comprises six exclusive luxury villas: Claudius Villa, Marcus Aurelius Villa, Constantine Villa, Hadrian Villa, Titus Villa and Trajan Villa.


**How much does it cost to reserve a villa at THE VILLAS Caesars Palace?**


Rates for THE VILLAS Caesars Palace vary by villa type, travel dates and length of stay. **About Caesars Palace**


Caesars Palace, the iconic Las Vegas Strip resort where every guest is treated like a Caesar, features 3,980 hotel guest rooms and[suites](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Flas-vegas%2Fsuites&esheet=54620399&newsitemid=20261012086525&lan=en-US&anchor=suites&index=11&md5=20b20878127b20ce1d5c24aebc5a2596) , including the redesigned 182-room[Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Fnobu-caesars-palace&esheet=54620399&newsitemid=20261012086525&lan=en-US&anchor=Nobu+Hotel+Caesars+Palace&index=12&md5=e231fb64b702161863113db86c02ea76) , the renovated Colosseum Tower and[THE VILLAS Caesars Palace](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Fsuites%2Flas-vegas%2Fvillas&esheet=54620399&newsitemid=20261012086525&lan=en-US&anchor=THE+VILLAS+Caesars+Palace&index=13&md5=a9ceece66fcd5277c8a329ec2ed89ce4) , which has earned the prestigious AAA Five Diamond rating. Both Caesars Palace and Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace have also received AAA Four Diamond designations. The 85-acre resort offers diverse dining options from the award-winning Bacchanal Buffet to celebrity chef-branded restaurants, including Gordon Ramsay HELL’S KITCHEN, Pronto by Giada, Amalfi by Bobby Flay, Vanderpump Cocktail Garden by restaurateur and television star Lisa Vanderpump, one of Nobu Matsuhisa’s largest Nobu restaurants, MICHELIN-starred Restaurant Guy Savoy, award-winning pastry chef Dominique Ansel’s first Las Vegas bakery, Stanton Social Italian – a dining concept in partnership with Tao Group Hospitality, legendary New York Steak House Peter Luger and Brasserie B Parisian Steakhouse by Bobby Flay. The Celebrity Food Hall features Guy Fieri’s Chicken Guy!, Bobby’s Burgers by Bobby Flay, Tortazo by Rick Bayless, Buddy V’s Pizzeria and Mokbar by Esther Choi. For the best in cocktails, destination lounges include Montecristo Cigar Bar, VISTA Cocktail Lounge, Stadia Bar and Caspian’s – a cocktail and caviar bar with Clique Hospitality. The resort also features nearly 130,000 square feet of casino space, the Caesars Race & Sportsbook at Caesars Palace with a 143-foot HD LED screen and state-of-the-art sound, a five-acre Garden of the Gods Pool Oasis, the luxurious Qua Baths & Spa, Hairdreams by Michael Boychuck, five wedding chapels and gardens, the 75,000-square-foot OMNIA Nightclub and OMNIA Dayclub & Skybar on Las Vegas Boulevard. The 4,300-seat Colosseum is the most celebrated venue in Las Vegas with an impressive legacy of superstar talent featured in an intimate, once-in-a-lifetime setting. The Colosseum currently spotlights world-class entertainers, including LISA, Nikki Glaser and David Spade, Sting and Tim McGraw. Also, the Green Fairy Garden in front of Caesars Palace hosts ABSINTHE by Spiegelworld, an adults-only circus variety show featuring a cocktail of wild and outlandish acts. The Forum Shops at Caesars Palace showcases more than 160 boutiques and restaurants. Caesars Palace is operated by a subsidiary of Caesars Entertainment, Inc. (NASDAQ: CZR). **About The Vanderpump Hotel**


The Vanderpump Hotel is a first-of-its-kind destination on the Las Vegas Strip, created by renowned restaurateur and television personality Lisa Vanderpump in partnership with Caesars Entertainment. Blending elevated design with a distinct sense of personality, The Vanderpump Hotel introduces a boutique, lifestyle-driven hospitality experience in the heart of one of the world’s most dynamic destinations. Located on the iconic corner of Las Vegas Boulevard and Flamingo Road, directly across from Caesars Palace, the hotel offers an intimate footprint with 188 guest rooms, including 21 suites. The AAA Four Diamond-designated property features a 40,000-square-foot casino; Gigolo, a sexy, sultry lounge and The Bar at The Vanderpump Hotel, an inviting destination in the center of the casino – all curated to deliver a sophisticated yet playful atmosphere. Culinary and nightlife offerings are anchored by GIADA, the award-winning flagship restaurant from celebrity chef Giada De Laurentiis; Soleia, a 65,000-square-foot rooftop pool and event space with open-air, panoramic views from 11 stories above the Las Vegas skyline; and Drai’s After Hours, located in its original home beneath the hotel. Caesars Sportsbook at The Vanderpump Hotel provides a boutique, lounge-style setting for sports fans and gaming enthusiasts alike. The Vanderpump Hotel is operated by a subsidiary of Caesars Entertainment, Inc. (NASDAQ: CZR).
